scope: Playwright engine; not real-device Safari or user comprehension research
checks: completed reload and navigation preserve session, drafts, action and exact logs without API requests
explicit reset clears the same-tab checkpoint across reload
reload with a real committed response held preserves its key; explicit resume returns one SQL-backed action
restored historical labels and action remain readable without document overflow at four widths
injected session-expiry preflight stops continuation while preserving historical evidence
damaged checkpoint is rejected without breaking the page
stored serving exception and recovery layouts work in the selected browser engine
injected localStorage and sessionStorage denial keeps live execution usable with an explicit no-restore warning
